SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To embody divine law, cosmic order, and prophetic wisdom; to maintain balance through justice.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The eternal principle of right order and divine law.

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Oracle at Delphi before Apollo; invoked in oaths and legal proceedings; goddess of assemblies and counsel.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Pre-Olympian oracle deity absorbed into Zeus's reign; mother of the Horae (Seasons) and Moirai (Fates).

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted holding scales and sword, often blindfolded; seated on throne or at Delphic tripod; radiating authority.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: First voice of Delphi, mother of order, who weighs the cosmos in eternal balance.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A blindfolded figure holding scales that measure not weight but truth itself

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoked for fair judgment, prophetic insight, and establishment of divine order in human affairs.
AIPromptSeeds: An oracle whose every word reshapes the law of nations.
The judge who sees beyond appearance to the truth of cosmic order.
NarrativeHooks: The prophecy that cannot be avoided
The law that transcends human understanding
